reviewer: Codex project AI cross-review agent /root/last_response_cross_review; not an independent human reviewer
reviewMethod: Independent semantic cross review of all forty original replies and actual generated dialogue histories against the frozen exposed development cases/rubric. No ideal assistant injection; no other target reviews, reserved suite or model inference used. Boolean dimensions mark only score 1; additional dimensionScores and criterionScores preserve 0/0.5/1 judgments. criticalError records only concrete assertions judged incompatible with frozen facts or lacking basis; omissions and unintelligible text alone are not critical. Technical failures are recorded separately. Assessor also mechanically flags every positive discarded-token count; small system-only discards are distinguished from necessary dialogue-history loss.
limits: Autoría y revisión de IA del proyecto, no panel humano independiente.
Diez diálogos cotidianos y cuarenta turnos; cobertura limitada, sin garantía de generalización fuera de esta prueba.
No acredita habilidades autónomas, herramientas ejecutadas, memoria persistente, entrenamiento provocado por una charla ni trabajo real fuera de la conversación.
No contiene datos personales del creador; las situaciones son originales y ficticias.
